says: What the author and the agent said, turn by turn, as it was said: the thinking before it became a decision. Each turn follows the one before.

The pages the conversation offers an observatory: for each thing the author said that work followed, what followed it. Each row is a page: where it is written, what it looks through, and the thing it is the page of. Placed by the lens of an observatory's site; the conversation itself publishes nothing.

What followed a thing the author said: his words, and from that moment until he spoke again - what was done in each place, which signs were seen or came to something, what was learned looking back, what else was entered or changed, by kind, what was released, and the ideas the work was made standing on. Read off the records of work by their moments: nothing is written for it. Looked through from a turn - what-followed@conversation/turns:id - or from anywhere else, what followed the latest thing he said.
